name: 反応候補とコメント入力のフッター
prompt:
Create a clean, compact comment-reaction footer image matching the Japanese native preview at exactly 390x116 proportions. Use the native preview as authority for localization, colors and layout; use the original screenshot crop only for emoji sequence and source structure.

At the top, show one evenly spaced row of exactly eight reaction emojis in this order: ❤️, 🙌, 🔥, 👏, 💚, 😍, 😮, 🙄. Preserve their emoji artwork and relative sizes as closely as possible. Below, show a pale mint circular avatar with the hiragana あ at the left. To its right, draw a white rounded input capsule with a thin light-gray outline and the exact gray placeholder コメントを追加.

There is no hyperlink text in this component. Keep the placeholder gray and do not color it blue. Do not add a send button, count, label, or extra icon. Match the reference’s compact vertical spacing, white background, and 390x116 aspect ratio. Output only the component.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
